header.notes: Organization: Banff, Yoho and Kootenay National Parks. Observer: Ian Jackson. Snowpit depth 213 cm; Snowpack depth 213 cm. Aspect '--'. Blowing snow: None, --. Ski Pen. (PS) '--'. No time printed. Notes box: '43 on HINT board. A few hours later, field team was up on ridge above Simpson 3 and triggered a truck sized cornice chunk which triggered a size 3 avalanche in Simpson 3. Ran on a SC (likely Feb 11th). Details: SE aspect at 2300m, 50-100 deep with fracture line 200-300m wide and ran for ~ 1000m. Yikes!' Surface (hatched row above HS): asterisk-over-triangle glyph 3 mm (no water content). Chart id 56E8220B72457C0F00577A35.

transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (11.51 px/cm). Boundaries printed on the right axis (176/172 fanned out by a slanted leader); bar edges agree with every printed value. Hardness from bar ends vs gridlines (I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 707/967/1227/1487/1747/2007 px, 260 px per class); 172-140 bar slanted from exactly 1F to exactly P. All six left-side boxes are free text without a bold test code; their dashed leaders sit at 193, 176, 172, 140, 99 and 70 cm. Boxes with test results (176, 172) recorded as tests (one entry per result, full text in raw); date/label boxes (140, 99, 70) recorded as date_tag on the layer whose top is at the leader (interface rule); the undated 'Thin MFC' box (193) goes to that layer's comment. Temperatures are break points of a continuous red polyline without markers (fitted segment intersections), calibration x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T(C): dashed air segment ends at -2.0 C = printed air temp, all break points on 0.5 C steps; +-0.2 C / +-0.5 cm; 100-20 cm is one straight segment (collinear points cannot be recovered). Water content column blank for all layers. No red highlights, no density column.
